cross_archive_invariants: v0.6 SHALL NOT read content from Conan Xin Archive (no URL fetch / git clone / API call / iFrame)
v0.6 SHALL NOT write to Conan Xin Archive (no INSERT / UPDATE / git push)
v0.6 SHALL NOT introduce submodule / symlink / hardlink to Archive
v0.6 SHALL NOT introduce Notion / Obsidian / Roam API integration
v0.6 MAY reference Archive-issued IDs (rq_*, FN_*, gap_*) by string only
v0.6 SHALL display a 'Pending Archive Link' placeholder for any Archive-issued ID referenced but not resolvable
